title: Sleep Timer Brief
brief: Add a sleep timer to the players so playback stops after a set time or at the end of the episode.
summary: A sleep timer in every player: pick 15, 30 or 60 minutes or *End of episode*, and playback fades out and pauses. The server only remembers each profile's last choice.
decided: **Remembered:** per profile, on the server, so it follows you between devices.
defaults: The last minute fades the volume out rather than cutting it.
A new optional `sleepTimer` field on profile settings; older apps ignore it.

rows.what: Timer button and Live Activity countdown
In the player's options menu only
